name: Pasguard Cuirass
description: Settle the weight on the rear leg with the arm half extended to prepare a lunge of greater length.

name: Mightfleche
description: Spring from the rear thigh in a flat drive so the body travels low and long over the ground.

name: Unmaking Volte
description: Reach the point past its usual length by dropping the shoulder and following with a full body extension.

name: Torrent Cupedge
description: Haul the rear foot forward and rise to guard after a long lunge so the body is not stranded.

name: Sweptbarrage
description: Run two quick steps and lunge from the second so the foe has no time to measure the approach.

name: Ravaging Cuphilt
description: Drop into a deep lunge beneath the foe's parry so the point rises into the chest from below.

name: Unmaking Remise
description: Keep the arm locked at full reach after the lunge so the foe cannot close past the point.

name: Hollowfleche
description: Gather qi through the whole body in the held stance and release it in a lunge so long the foe's retreat is outrun.

name: Foilassault
description: Fall forward into a flat lunge that drives through the foe's raised guard and breaks his stance.

name: Ponderous Stoccata
description: Hover the point near the foe's lead hand so any motion he makes invites a thrust.

name: Voltespurt
description: Slip the body aside by half a pace in the same beat the foe's thrust begins.

name: Waning Sweephilt
description: Watch the foe's eyes and shoulders together for the flicker that comes before every attack.

name: Glint Whipblade
description: Lead with the shoulder to hide the start of the thrust and drive the point at the throat.

name: Scalding Lunge
description: Lunge into the instant the foe begins his own thrust so his motion carries him onto your point.

name: Unflinching Counterpoise
description: Slip the head aside and parry with the forte then send the point back along the foe's arm.

name: Rumble Slimtang
description: Show an opened line to draw his thrust then beat it away with qi and strike before his arm returns.

name: Hamstringing Needlepoint
description: Hold the point on his centre line and press with qi each time he starts a step so his rhythm breaks.

name: Chime Cuphilt
description: Spread the field of qi along the blade to its tip and feel the air before the point.

name: Glint Fleche
description: Push the point forward on a pulse of field qi so it lands a finger beyond the physical reach.

name: Equipoise Counterpoise
description: Let the field around the blade brush aside a thrust before the steel itself is touched.

name: Tipwhip Tincture
description: Pour a steady stream of qi into the tip so it does not tremble when the arm tires.

name: Might Volte
description: Draw the field back into the body as the arm recoils so the guard returns whole.

name: Rumblefoil
description: Lunge with the field narrowed to a needle along the blade so the point pierces light armour.

name: Mantled Needlepoint
description: Spread a thin veil of field qi before the blade to dull each probing thrust.

name: Toxinvolte
description: Send a sharp pulse of qi through the point on contact to jar the foe's blade from his line.

name: Volteassault
description: Shape the field into a lance of qi that follows the thrust and pierces a guard the steel could not.

name: Paralyzing Remise
description: Wrap the foe's blade in the field around your own and hold it fast while the point goes in.

name: Hoarfrost Bellguard
description: Stand with point foot hip and heel in one straight line toward the foe and hold it.

name: Torrent Stoccata
description: Move forward or back along the line in a single quick pulse without letting the blade drift off it.

name: Verityswept
description: Feel through the field whether the foe's weight and blade stand upon your line or beside it.

name: Novafleche
description: Thrust straight down the line and withdraw along it without bending the wrist or the elbow.

name: Gust Slimtang
description: Slide the forte across the foe's blade to move it off the line and keep the point where it was.

name: Torrent Bellguard
description: Rest a breath on the line after each exchange and recover the stance without moving the point.

name: Tipwhip Onslaught
description: Lunge along the line after the foe and follow his retreat with a second step and the same point.

name: Hour Passata
description: Lean qi down the length of the blade onto the line so the foe cannot step across it.

name: Remisehauberk
description: Beat across the foe's blade at the middle of the line to cut his guard from his thrust.

name: Tiered Passata
description: Chain three lunges along one line each carried by its own pulse of field qi with no pause between them.

name: Trouncing Pasguard
description: Fill the foe's line with thrusts of qi so every road to your body is shut while he stands.

name: Hoarfrost Whipblade
description: Hold the blade on two tracks at once with the point covering one line and the hilt the other.

name: Careening Sweephilt
description: Step along a clean straight line toward or away from the foe in the smooth manner of the school.

name: Veritypas
description: Watch the foe's blade and his feet as two tracks and read which one will move first.

name: Facet Lunge
description: Fix on a single spot of the foe's chest and send the point to it without any warning wave.

name: Blurring Bellguard
description: Fall back in a shallow curve like the lip of a basin so the foe's line misses by a hand.

name: Murk Sweephilt
description: Parry with the forte on one track and thrust on the other in a single answering motion.

name: Mayhemswept
description: Beat the foe's steel twice in quick succession then slip around it into the line left bare.

name: Unflinching Pasguard
description: Turn the blade in a slow round like a river bend to draw the foe's thrust wide.

name: Remisetorment
description: Parry on the first track with a pulse of qi and strike on the second so one motion gives two answers.

name: Remise Barrage
description: Sweep the foe's thrust aside and carry the same sweep across to cut the exposed wrist with the edge.

name: Thorn Counterpoise
description: Raise the blade high with the point hanging down in the manner of a hawk poised upon a bough.

name: Torrent Passata
description: Lean the whole body forward over the front foot so the next step becomes a fall.

name: Sweptlinctus
description: Look down along the blade at the foe's whole figure and judge where the stoop will strike.

name: Severing Fleche
description: Strike downward with the point like a talon at the chest or shoulder of a foe below the line.

name: Equipoise Cupedge
description: Sweep the blade wide like a wing to brush a thrust off the high line.

name: Might Stoccata
description: Retreat along a curved line so the foe's pursuit passes across the open centre of the arc.

name: Whipblade Thrash
description: Fall into the lunge from the perch with a pulse of qi so the first step already carries the point.

name: Facet Needlepoint
description: Dive low beneath the foe's blade and thrust upward before he can bring the guard down.

name: Charter Volte
description: Hold the high point above the foe's head and press his guard upward until the chest opens.

name: Reverie Slimtang
description: Flap the blade out wide as though beginning a sweep then stoop straight in on the opposite line.

name: Cuphilt Onslaught
description: Drop from the high guard in one long stoop and drive the point down into the chest with all the weight behind it.

name: Foilcuirass
description: Pin the foe's blade to the ground with the stooping point and strike his unguarded forearm.

name: Remnant Slimtang
description: Spread the field along two tracks one on the blade and one on the ground to read both foe and floor.

name: Unshaken Tipwhip
description: Brush the foe's thrust with a paired touch of field and steel so it slides past either flank.

name: Gust Lunge
description: Step with the flow of the foe's advance and glide beside it as water goes beside a stone.

name: Trouncing Cupedge
description: Thrust along a ruled line of the school with the elbow close and no motion wasted.

name: Torrent Sweephilt
description: Parry on one court of the body and thrust from the other so guard and answer come as a pair.

name: Lunge Fastness
description: Show the foe a feint on the field track while the true thrust runs on the steel track.

name: Enduring Cuphilt
description: Curve the field into a shallow bowl before the body to catch and hold a weak thrust.

name: Facet Stoccata
description: Lunge with one point of steel and one of field qi so the foe can only parry the first.

name: Silencing Fastening Needlepoint
description: Seal the foe's blade against his body with a track of field qi and thrust along the other.

name: Swepthauberk
description: Sink low with the blade level like a stone set in a riverbed that the current must pass.

name: Fleche Leap
description: Slip sideways along the foe's thrust so his weight falls past you and not through you.

name: Remnant Bellguard
description: Let the field carry back the faint echo of the foe's movement as a basin returns a call.

name: Whipblade Fastness
description: Turn the blade in a small eddy to swirl the foe's point off its line and into the air.

name: Cupedge Barrage
description: Thrust along the direction of the foe's own motion so his push becomes your reach.

name: Pasguard Spurt
description: Pace back against the foe's advance in short strides that give ground and keep the line.

name: Pashauberk
description: Join the parry and the riposte into one flowing stroke like two streams meeting in one bed.

name: Lungecuirass
description: Circle the point around the foe's blade in an eddy until it is bound against his own hilt.

name: Wrecking Passata
description: Press forward with repeated thrusts like a swelling flood so the foe has no time to answer.

name: Doctrine Counterpoise
description: Turn parry into riposte and riposte into parry in a ring that carries on until the foe breaks.

name: Sweptthrash
description: Gather qi like a river held behind a bank and release it in a lunge that shatters the foe's guard.

name: Aegispas
description: Plant the feet on a chosen bearing toward the foe and hold the blade steady upon it.

name: Flechepounce
description: Turn on the ball of the heel as a vane turns in the wind to keep the bearing as the foe moves.

name: Waning Tipwhip
description: Look at the foe as at the far edge of a plateau and measure the space left before him.

name: Facet Remise
description: Send the point along the bearing taken in one straight pass and let it keep its line to the end.

name: Needlepoint Greave
description: Parry without leaving the bearing and thrust back along it before the foe resets his arm.

name: Foilbarrage
description: Lunge only as far as the bearing allows and return to it so the body keeps its word.

name: Scalding Fleche
description: Drive qi down the sworn bearing in a single lunge that nothing the foe interposes can turn.

name: Steadfast Equipoise Cuphilt
description: Sweep a thrust aside like a gust across the plateau and cut the foe's forearm on the return.

name: Facetswept
description: Hold the blade slightly off the foe's line so a straight thrust slides along it and away.

name: Gust Volte
description: Skip lightly to the side in a quick gust of movement that leaves the foe's point empty.

name: Verity Tipwhip
description: Feel the draft of the foe's moving blade on the skin to learn which way it will turn.

name: Pascloak
description: Flick the point lightly as a leaf in the breeze to draw the foe's blade to the wrong side.

name: Nova Stoccata
description: Slide a thrust in on the draft of the foe's own parry before it settles.

name: Reverie Pasguard
description: Slip the point around the foe's blade as a wind turns a corner and lunge into the bare line.

name: Staunch Sweephilt
description: Veer the point aside at the last moment so the foe's beat strikes only air.

name: Rumble Lunge
description: Drift the point along the foe's blade and tap it sharply to throw his hand off line.

name: Mayhem Fleche
description: Veer around two parries in a single sweep of qi and strike the line that opens at the end.

name: Foilgreave
description: Spin the blade in a gale-quick turn that drives the foe's thrust wide and returns along it.

name: Granite Whipblade
description: Stand with the point sworn to the foe's centre and refuse to turn it aside for any feint.

name: Gust Cupedge
description: Rise on the toes and step forward on the foe's lifting weight like a gust going up a slope.

name: Bellguard Elixir
description: Let the field reach far out like a wind across the plateau and feel any blade that stirs in it.

name: Scalding Passata
description: Thrust into the foe's face as into a headwind with the shoulders braced and the point unwavering.

name: Equipoise Slimtang
description: Turn a thrust to the lee side of the blade so its force spends itself past the body.

name: Gustfoil
description: Let the wind of the thrust carry the body back to guard in a single smooth stride.

name: Tempered Counterpoise
description: Throw qi behind the lunge like a gale at the back so the point lands with extra weight.

name: Intentpas
description: Press forward on a held bearing with the point at the foe's chest and give him no room to turn.

name: Remise Fastness
description: Bind the foe's blade with the forte and keep it bound until the point has been delivered.

name: Rumble Volte
description: Strike the foe's blade with a sudden gust of force to knock the point off its line.

name: Drubbing Fleche
description: Gather the whole field behind the point as a gale gathers over the plateau then loose it in one thrust.

name: Gust Needlepoint
description: Meet the foe's thrust with a parry carrying a gust of qi that jars the sword from line and grip.

name: Immovable Tipwhip
description: Stand firm with the blade upon the bearing and the feet set to turn as the foe turns.

name: Silt Bellguard
description: Slide the feet across the ground in the brisk steps of a wind crossing open country.

name: Discerning Pasguard
description: Check by eye and field whether the bearing is still true after the foe has moved.

name: Glint Volte
description: Thrust at an even speed along the bearing like a steady wind that does not gust or fail.

name: Splitting Cupedge
description: Cross the ground in two gale-quick steps and finish the second as a lunge with qi behind it.

name: Sweephilt Cuirass
description: Turn the whole body about the bearing as a vane turns on its post and sweep the thrust wide.

name: Mayhemremise
description: Walk the point across the foe's face in a slow wind-like drift then lunge from the far side.

name: Scything Lunge
description: Drive qi through a lunge that carries the point to the very edge of the foe's reach and past it.

name: Flechecloak
description: Beat the foe off his own bearing with a pulse of qi and thrust into the line he has lost.
